query:
SELECT streamer_login AS "streamer_login!",
                    twitch_user_id AS "twitch_user_id!"
               FROM twitch_live_state
              WHERE is_live = 1
                AND active_session_id IS NOT NULL
                AND TRIM(COALESCE(streamer_login, '')) <> ''
                AND TRIM(COALESCE(twitch_user_id, '')) <> ''
